title: Named Entity Recognition
seoDescription: Tag tokenized sentences with dictionary-backed named entity labels while preserving sentence and token order.
description:
Assign entity category labels (e.g. 'PER', 'LOC', 'ORG', 'O') to sequence tokens using entity dictionary mapping.

$$
y_i = \begin{cases} \text{entity\_dict}(t_i) & \text{if } t_i \in \text{entity\_dict} \\ \text{'O'} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}
$$

Given input parameters `tokens`, `entity_dict`, return list of entity tag strings matching input sequence length.
